samples.question: The image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). Each quadrant contains one dark stroke. A stroke is bowed when it bulges clearly out of the straight line joining its two ends; it is straight when it follows that line. Exactly three of the four strokes share the SAME form (all bowed or all straight); the fourth stroke has the opposite form. Which quadrant contains the oddly formed stroke (the one that is bowed when the other three are straight, or straight when the other three are bowed)? Answer with one quadrant name.
